snippet.title: The Most Valuable Real Estate Training You'll Ever Watch
snippet.description:
If you are an accredited investor and are interested in investing with The Founders Group and Ken follow this link to sign up: https://thefoundersgroup.com/investor/?utm_source=youtube

Ken McElroy just put a 258-unit Phoenix apartment building in escrow for $36 million. In 2021, that same property was worth almost $75 million. In this training he breaks down exactly how that happens and why right now reminds him of 2008, the last time he bought aggressively.

He walks through why the market repriced (inflation spiked, the Fed hiked rates late, mortgages jumped, and valuations collapsed), how rising debt turned cash-flowing deals negative, and the supply glut that made it worse. Then the part everyone wants: when to enter a market, which markets to buy first, how he reads migration data like driver's licenses and U-Haul moves, and why the rent-versus-buy affordability gap is the widest he has seen in 23 years.

Finally, the three reasons he is buying multifamily now: a real housing shortage, valuations down 30 to 50 percent, and relentless renter demand. This is educational, not investment advice.
